subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Describe, compare and order up to 20 objects
source.subtopic: Compare collections of objects: many, fewer, most, least; more than, less than; the same as, just as many, different

show.line: Seven cups and seven saucers. Just as many! The same number. Let's compare big groups.

rounds.prompt: Which row has just as many as the row of eight spoons?
Count the children. Is it the same as fourteen chairs? How many children?
rounds.praise: Fourteen! Just as many as the chairs.

rounds.prompt: Which group has more than twelve?
Nine birds and nine nests. Are they the same, or different? Say it.
Same as ten, or different? Sort the groups.

hints: Match them up one to one. Any left over? Then not the same.
Count both groups. Same number means just as many.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Seven cups, eight saucers.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Eight is one more than seven. Not the same.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's match them up. One saucer has no cup. Different!

parent_line: Can tell when two groups have the same number, more or fewer.
